text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerChain alert fired for inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1 — high 5xx error rate across API routes (generation/chat). Trigger: error_rate > 8% for 2min. PD: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345
IncidentBot: Summary: 5xx spike (502/504/500 mix). 1m p95 latency stable, error-rate rising. Affected: public hosted API + some dedicated pools in eu-west1. Suggested runbook: inference-5xx-spike-runbook v2.
PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 triggered, escalation policy: infra-oncall.
Alice M.: acked. I'm on it, jumping in — doing quick triage. Can someone post top failing endpoint and sample logs?
Bob SRE: I see a correlated bump in upstream 502s from model-router-eu-1. Pulling logs now.
Bob SRE: (logs snippet)
```
2026-03-14T21:01:02Z inference-gateway: upstream=model-router-eu-1 status=502 path=/v1/generate client_id=acct_123
2026-03-14T21:01:05Z inference-gateway: upstream=model-router-eu-1 status=502 path=/v1/chat client_id=acct_456
2026-03-14T21:01:07Z model-router-eu-1: conn_reset error writing to backend model-worker-7
```
Bob SRE: Model-router reports connection resets to backend workers. 502s are dominating. Not seeing increased latency from gateway itself.
DeployBot: Last deploy to model-router-eu-1: 2026-03-14T20:45:00Z by ci-pipeline #4821 (image: model-router:sha-9f8ab).
Elena EngInfra: I'm checking GPU node metrics for model-worker pool. Early sign: node gpu-07 had OOMs and kernel restarts around 20:50Z. Could be a runaway job.
Carla (PM): Any idea on customer impact? Are production customers seeing failed requests or degraded throughput?
David (Support): Monitoring shows ~12% of requests for hosted-api returned 5xx in the last 5m. We have one support ticket from AcmeCorp (high-usage) reporting "generation fails with 502". Potentially affecting paid customers.
Alice M.: Good to know. Triage plan: 1) Silence PD noise on related alerts (silence 15m). 2) Scale model-worker pool in eu-west1 (+2 nodes) and restart suspected model-worker hosts. 3) If routing still fails, failover traffic to fallback model-variant in other region or lower-capacity replica. 4) Post incident start + customer impact.
Alice M.: Silencing noisy alerts now. `pagerctl silence --policy inference-5xx --15m` — done.
Bob SRE: Scaling pool: `infractl scale --pool model-worker-eu-west --add 2` — submitted. ETA ~90s for new nodes.
Elena EngInfra: I'm kicking a graceful restart for gpu-07: `ssh ops@gpu-07 -- sudo systemctl restart model-worker`. Will monitor logs.
Bob SRE: While scaling, I'm enabling request-level fallback to model-variant v1-small for non-critical routes: `confctl set routing /v1/generate fallback_model=v1-small` — applied. This should reduce pressure on heavy workers.
Alice M.: Noting that p50/p95 latency unchanged; error rate started to drift down after fallback at ~21:04Z.
DeployBot: New nodes up: gpu-12 & gpu-13 joined pool at 21:05:32Z.
Bob SRE: gpu-07 restarted, logs show fewer conn_reset events. Still a handful of 502s but trending down.
David (Support): Customer-impact line: AcmeCorp requests failing reduced from 40% to 8% over 6 minutes after fallback. They're monitoring and will update if they see regressions.
Carla (PM): Thanks — please capture customer timeline and any SLA hits. We'll prepare outreach if it persists >30m.
Alice M.: Current status: error-rate reduced from 9.2% -> 2.1% in 10m. Rolling mitigation: scaled +2, restarted problem host, applied fallback routing. Keeping pager open for now. Next steps: 1) keep monitoring 2) continue spike analysis (why worker OOMed) 3) create incident ticket and postmortem.
Bob SRE: I will dig into model-worker logs and memory traces, suspect a memory leak in model-worker v2. Filing an infra bug: https://issues.example/INFRA-9876.
Alice M.: PD: acknowledging handoff — I'll stay on until stable and then hand over to the rotation oncall in 30m. @Bob SRE pls take primary follow-up for the root cause.
PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by Alice M.
Alice M.: quick note: created incident doc draft: https://docs.internal/incidents/2026-03-14-5xx-tide — will finish with timeline and RCA.
Elena EngInfra: Adding a short-term alert to watch for OOM regressions and auto-scale threshold tweak suggested.
Carla (PM): Requesting an incident postmortem and customer impact summary by EOD.
Alice M.: Thanks all. Closing immediate paging chain — will update thread with final timeline and actions. If error rate creeps back up, PD will re-fire. :white_check_mark:
